title: 芝士
lede: Before 芝士 sends a message, opens a task, decides a review or manages members for you, it checks whether you asked for that action. If you didn't, it asks you to confirm in the panel first. Only you can change this page.

always.desc: 芝士 asks you to confirm these actions every time before taking them.
